title: Backend Engineer (Phase 2 check)

# Backend Engineer

## About the role
We are hiring a Backend Engineer to build and run the REST APIs behind our product.

## What you'll do
- Design and build REST APIs in Python
- Model data and tune queries in PostgreSQL
- Package and deploy services with Docker
- Review code and improve reliability

## What you'll bring
### Must have
- 2+ years of professional backend experience
- Python and FastAPI
- PostgreSQL
- Docker

### Nice to have
- AWS
- Redis

We are hiring a Frontend Developer to build the web interface of our product.

## What you'll bring

- React

title: Data Analyst (Phase 2 check)
markdown:
# Data Analyst

## About the role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to turn business data into clear reports and dashboards. Freshers and people with up to two years of experience are welcome.

## What you'll do
- Query data with SQL
- Build dashboards in Tableau or Power BI
- Analyse trends in Excel
- Present findings to managers

## What you'll bring
### Must have
- SQL
- Excel
- A BI tool such as Tableau or Power BI

### Nice to have
- Python
- Statistics

## What we offer
- [Salary range]

## Equal opportunity
We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.
